title: One-man lift vs heavy ply

scenes.video_prompt: Vertical handheld video shot on an Indian residential construction site, natural daylight. Two tired Indian construction laborers in dusty clothes struggling together to lift and carry one heavy, water-stained, dark brown wooden shuttering plywood sheet across an uneven RCC slab floor. Camera moves slightly showing the heavy strain and effort. Realistic site atmosphere, raw phone footage style, no text anywhere, no logos, no dialogue.
